Source   Edit  

Config loader — reads donkey.toml, applies env overrides, returns defaults gracefully when the file is missing or unparseable.

Priority (highest to lowest):

  1. DONKEY_HOME env var (for home dir only)
  2. Values in donkey.toml
  3. Built-in defaults (see config/types.nim)
